name: Pinscher
tagline: Control a Mac hands-free with finger pinches, swipes and voice, and turn recorded sessions into slide decks.

awards: 2nd Place - General Challenge // 2eme place – Défi général

problem: Computer use is a stream of manual clicks and keystrokes, and harder for people with limited mobility.
solution: A multi-process app tracks hand gestures for clicking, dragging and tab switching, interprets spoken intents such as summarising a meeting into a PDF, and uses Gemini to build Marp slide decks with speaker notes; dwell-click and sticky-key modes aid accessibility.
demo_moment: Team-described: pinch to click, swipe to switch tabs, then generate a deck from a recording.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “2nd Place - General Challenge // 2eme place – Défi général” among 260 submissions.
Combines gesture, voice and generation in one controller.

lessons: Gesture control demos well when each gesture maps to one obvious action.
